name: Get Paging Token
summary: Turns a date into a 'nextPageToken' — the starting point for pulling activities, lead changes, or deleted leads from that moment onward.
whenToUse: Always run this first when you want activity history. Example: to pull activities from September 1st, use date 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z, then feed the token into Get Lead Activities.

query.name: date
query.label: Start from date/time (UTC)
query.hint: Optional. ISO-8601 UTC datetime to start from, e.g. 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z. Leave blank to get a token for 'now' (only recent activity).

response.description: A 'pagingToken' string — pass it as nextPageToken to Get Lead Activities / Get Lead Changes / Get Deleted Leads.

notes: This call can take a while on busy instances (Marketo allows it up to 300s).
